title: RsigmaConfigPartial
description: Top-level layered configuration. All sections optional.

version.description: Config schema version, reserved for future migrations.

log_format.description: Diagnostic log format on stderr: `text` or `json` (maps to `--log-format`).

rules.description: Path to a Sigma rule file or directory.

pipelines.description: Builtin pipeline names or YAML file paths.

stix_store.description: Local STIX store root for `type: stix` enrichers (`stix-enrich` feature).

stix_store_allow_custom.description: Parse custom STIX types when loading `stix_store` (MITRE ATT&CK).

alert_pipeline.description: Alert-pipeline config file (dedup, grouping, silencing, inhibition).

risk.description: Risk-based alerting config file (annotation + per-entity risk incidents).

nats.description: Non-secret NATS knobs. Ignored unless built with `daemon-nats`.

dispositions.description: Triage feedback loop (analyst dispositions + per-rule false-positive ratio).

capture.description: Verdict-driven evidence capture. Startup-only; changing it requires a restart.

addr.description:
Bind address for health, metrics, and the HTTP/OTLP API: a TCP
`host:port`, or on Unix `unix:///path/to.sock` (TLS is rejected on a
unix:// address).

tls.description:
TLS settings. Ignored unless built with `daemon-tls`, except
`allow_plaintext`, which applies to every build.

auth.description:
Bearer-token authentication with `resource:action` permissions.
Absent = no authentication, which a non-loopback TCP address refuses
unless `allow_unauthenticated` is set.

allow_unauthenticated.description:
Serve the API without authentication on a non-loopback TCP address
(no `auth` block, no `--api-token-env`, no TLS client CA). Default:
false, so such a daemon refuses to start.

audit.description:
Control-plane API audit trail (requires `--state-db`). Auto-enabled
when a state database is configured; tune retention or disable here.

TlsPartial.description: Server-side TLS settings (no key password; that stays env-only).

allow_plaintext.description:
Serve plaintext on a non-loopback TCP address. Applies to every build,
with or without `daemon-tls`. Default: false.

AuthPartial.description:
Bearer-token authentication for the daemon API. Token secrets never live
in YAML: each token names an environment variable resolved at startup.

anonymous_permissions.description:
Permissions granted to requests with no `Authorization` header
(e.g. `["metrics:read"]` keeps Prometheus scraping token-free, or
`["*:read"]` protects only mutating endpoints). Default: none.
`GET /healthz` and `GET /readyz` are always open.

roles.description:
Operator-defined roles: role name to `resource:action` permission
list (`*` wildcards allowed, e.g. `"*:read"`, `"silences:*"`).
Merged over the built-in roles (reader, operator, ingest, admin),
which cannot be redefined.

AuthTokenPartial.description:
One bearer token: a name (for logs and metrics), exactly one of `role` /
`permissions`, and the environment variable holding the secret.

name.description: Token name, used in audit logs; never the secret.

role.description: A built-in (reader, operator, ingest, admin) or operator-defined role.

permissions.description: Inline permission list, as an alternative to `role`.

token_env.description:
Environment variable holding the token secret. Required; the daemon
refuses to start when it is unset or empty.

AuditPartial.description:
Control-plane API audit trail settings (`daemon.api.audit`). Requires
`--state-db`; auto-enabled when a state database is configured.

enabled.description: Explicit enable/disable. Default: enabled when `--state-db` is set.

max_entries.description: Maximum rows retained after pruning (newest kept). Default: 10000.

max_age.description: Maximum age of retained rows (e.g. `720h`, `30d`). Default: 720h.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum request body bytes buffered for SHA-256 digest. Default: 65536.

sink.description:
Optional sink spec for audit JSON lines (`on_full=drop` appended when
absent). The SQLite table is always written when audit is enabled.

source.description:
Event source: `stdin`, `http`, `nats://host:port/subject`, or on Unix
`unix:///path/to.sock` (newline-delimited events over a Unix socket).

syslog_tz.description: Default timezone offset for RFC 3164 syslog.

syslog_strip_bom.description: Strip a leading UTF-8 BOM from RFC 5424 syslog messages (default true).

jq.description: jq filter to extract the event payload.

jsonpath.description: JSONPath query to extract the event payload.

sinks.description:
Detection sinks: `stdout`, `file://path`, `nats://host:port/subject`,
`otlp(s)://host:port` (gRPC), `otlphttp(s)://host:port` (HTTP); the `s`
variants use TLS. On Unix, `unix:///path/to.sock` writes NDJSON to a
local socket. Optional query suffixes: `?on_full=drop`,
`?format=ndjson|ocsf` (line sinks only: stdout, file, NATS, unix),
`?compression=gzip` and `?timeout=<duration>` (OTLP, default `10s`), and
for TLS `?ca=`, `?client_cert=`, `?client_key=`, `?tls_domain=`.

dlq.description: Dead-letter queue for events that fail processing.

retry_max.description: Max delivery retries per sink before a result is routed to the DLQ.

backoff_base_ms.description: Base backoff in milliseconds for the first sink delivery retry.

backoff_max_ms.description: Backoff ceiling in milliseconds for sink delivery retries.

batch_max.description: Max results drained into one sink delivery batch.

batch_flush_ms.description: Max time in milliseconds a partial sink batch waits before flushing.

webhooks.description:
Webhook config files or directories declaring template-driven HTTP
sinks (`--webhook`). Each path is loaded and validated at startup.

action.description: Action after a correlation fires: `alert` or `reset`.

max_state_entries.description:
Hard cap on `(correlation, group-key)` state entries before
stalest-first eviction (default 100,000).

max_group_entries.description:
Cap on retained entries within a single group's window state.
Unset means unbounded (the historical behavior).

timestamp_fields.description: Extra event field names for timestamp extraction.

timestamp_fallback.description: Behavior when no timestamp is found: `wallclock` or `skip`.

emit_detections.description:
Emit output for rules referenced by correlations, including
correlations that feed another correlation.

db.description: SQLite database for persisting correlation state.

strict_rules.description:
Refuse to load a rule set in which any rule fails to parse. Default:
false, so rules that fail to parse are skipped and only a load in
which every rule fails is refused.

cross_rule_ac.description: Cross-rule Aho-Corasick pre-filter. Ignored unless built with `daachorse-index`.

match_detail.description:
Match-detail verbosity for detection output: `off` (default),
`summary`, or `full`. Controls how much per-field match information
is attached to detection results.

egress_policy.description:
HTTP egress policy applied to dynamic-source and enrichment HTTP clients:
`default` (block link-local + cloud metadata), `strict` (also block
loopback + RFC1918 private), or `permissive` (allow everything).

NatsPartial.description: Non-secret NATS knobs. Secrets stay env-only.

consumer_group.description: Shared durable consumer name for load balancing.

TapPartial.description:
Live event-tap limits. The only flag is `--enable-tap`; the tuning keys
are config-file-only to keep the daemon flag surface minimal.

enabled.description:
Whether the `GET /api/v1/tap` endpoint accepts sessions (default
false; the tap is opt-in because it exfiltrates raw events). Enabled
by this key or the `--enable-tap` flag.

buffer_events.description:
Per-session bounded channel capacity. A full channel drops events
(counted) rather than applying backpressure to the engine.

max_sessions.description:
Maximum number of concurrent capture sessions (a new session over the
cap is rejected with `409`).

max_duration.description:
Largest capture window (humantime, e.g. `5m`); a longer `duration`
query param is rejected with `400`.

TailPartial.description:
Live detection-tail limits. The only flag is `--enable-tail`; the tuning
keys are config-file-only.

enabled.description:
Whether the `GET /api/v1/detections/stream` endpoint accepts sessions
(default false; opt-in like the event tap). Enabled by this key or the
`--enable-tail` flag.

buffer_events.description:
Per-session bounded channel capacity. A full channel drops detections
(counted) rather than applying backpressure to the sink task.

max_sessions.description:
Maximum number of concurrent tail sessions (a new session over the cap
is rejected with `409`).

DispositionsPartial.description:
Triage feedback loop settings (`daemon.dispositions.*`). Opt-in: the
disposition endpoints and the per-rule false-positive ratio are off until
enabled by this key or the `--enable-dispositions` flag.

enabled.description:
Whether `POST`/`GET /api/v1/dispositions` accept requests and the
per-rule false-positive ratio is computed. Default false.

source.description:
Optional pull source for dispositions (a file, HTTP, or NATS `--source`
style spec). When unset, dispositions arrive only over the endpoint.

window.description: Rolling window over which dispositions are counted (humantime, e.g. `30d`).

numerator.description:
Whether benign true positives count toward the ratio numerator:
`fp_only` (default) or `fp_and_btp`.

min_sample.description:
Minimum dispositions a rule needs in the window before its ratio is
published (so a single false positive cannot publish a misleading 100%).

enabled.description: Retain admitted detection events for later spooling. Default false.

spool_dir.description: Directory that receives completed disposition bundles. Required when enabled.

max_event_bytes.description: Maximum encoded JSON size of one event, in bytes.

max_bytes_per_incident.description: Maximum encoded JSON bytes retained for one incident.

max_capture_bytes.description: Maximum encoded JSON bytes retained across the ring.

ttl.description: Idle lifetime after last admission (humantime, e.g. `24h`).

max_spool_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of completed bundles kept under `spool_dir`.

spool_queue_capacity.description: Bounded queue of pending spool jobs.

SchemaPartial.description: Schema classification and routing settings (shared by `daemon` and `eval`).

observe.description: Enable the schema observer (daemon `--observe-schemas`). Ignored by eval.

discover.description:
Enable schema signature discovery sampling (daemon `--discover-schemas`;
implies `observe`). Ignored by eval.

config.description:
Path to the schema config file with signatures and routing bindings
(`--schema-config`).

field_map.description:
Event field names each logsource dimension is read from
(`--logsource-field-map`). Defaults to `product`/`service`/`category`.

event_logsource.description:
Static event logsource applied when the field is absent
(`--event-logsource`), for a single-source pipeline.

strict.description: Reserved for a future strict subset-routing mode. Currently ignored.

LogsourceDimensionsPartial.description:
A `{ product, service, category }` triple plus optional `custom` dimensions,
used for both the logsource field-name map and the static event-logsource
override. Custom entries map a dimension name to an event field name (in
`field_map`) or to a literal value (in `event_logsource`).

rules.description: Default rules path for `rsigma engine eval`.

syslog_strip_bom.description: Strip a leading UTF-8 BOM from RFC 5424 syslog messages (default true).

output.description:
Write detection and correlation results to this file instead of stdout
(`--output`).

rules.description: Default rules path for `rsigma rule backtest`.

corpus.description: Event corpus file(s) or directory(ies), walked recursively.

pipelines.description: Builtin pipeline names or YAML file paths.

input_format.description: Input log format for non-NDJSON corpus files.

syslog_tz.description: Default timezone offset for RFC 3164 syslog.

syslog_strip_bom.description: Strip a leading UTF-8 BOM from RFC 5424 syslog messages (default true).

rules.description: Sigma rule file(s) or directory(ies) to map onto ATT&CK.

atomics.description: Atomic Red Team index path/URL, or an `atomics/` directory.

baseline.description: Baseline ATT&CK Navigator layer path/URL (e.g. the SigmaHQ heatmap).

targets.description: Target technique list file (one technique ID per line).

fail_on_gaps.description:
Exit non-zero when a requested cross-reference reports uncovered
techniques.

ScorecardPartial.description:
`rsigma rule scorecard` settings. The verdict thresholds carry compiled
defaults; the inputs (including the two required JSON reports) and the report
path are opt-in.

coverage.description: The coverage JSON report (from `rule coverage --output-format json`).

metrics.description: Prometheus exposition snapshot path or `/metrics` URL for production volume.

metrics_window.description: Prometheus query-API range window (e.g. 7d) for last-fired and fire-rate.

triage.description: Triage disposition feed file for the live false-positive ratio and latency.

min_precision.description: Keep floor: precision proxy at or above this keeps the rule.

tune_max_precision.description: Upper edge of the review band (used in the tune reason).

retire_max_precision.description: Retire floor: precision proxy below this retires the rule.

min_volume.description: Minimum total volume for a keep verdict.

stale_window.description: Staleness window in days for the keep gate.

VisibilityPartial.description:
`rsigma rule visibility` settings. `rules` and `observed` are intentionally
absent: they are invocation-specific CLI arguments, not project defaults.

mapping.description:
Logsource/field to ATT&CK data-source mapping table path or URL. Unset
uses the bundled default table.

fail_on_blind_spots.description:
Exit non-zero when a rule-expected data source has no observed
telemetry (every mapped field sits in the broken-coverage `missing` set).

DocPartial.description:
`rsigma rule doc` settings. The ADS bar itself (enforced statuses and
required sections) lives in `.rsigma-lint.yml`, not here; this section only
carries the command's own defaults.

fail_on_missing.description:
Exit non-zero when any rule falls below the configured ADS bar (maps to
`--fail-on-missing`).

HygienePartial.description:
`rsigma rule hygiene` settings. The silence and staleness thresholds carry
compiled defaults; the inputs and the `--fail-on` policy are opt-in.

rules.description: Sigma rule file(s) or directory(ies) to report on.

metrics.description: Prometheus exposition snapshot path or `/metrics` URL for fire volume.

metrics_window.description: Prometheus query-API range window (e.g. 7d) for a true last-fired.

fields.description: A #55 field-observability JSON snapshot for the broken-coverage signal.

silent_threshold.description: Age past which a never-fired rule is a retirement candidate (e.g. 365d).

stale_threshold.description: Modified-date age past which a rule is flagged stale (e.g. 365d).

noisy_threshold.description: Absolute per-window fire ceiling that overrides the robust outlier test.

fail_on.description:
CI policy: which findings fail (silent, noisy, untagged, no-owner,
incomplete-ads, broken-fields, deprecated, any).

McpPartial.description:
`mcp serve` settings. The MCP HTTP auth token and the daemon token are
deliberately absent: secrets stay flag/env-only (`--auth-token` /
`RSIGMA_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN`, `--daemon-token` / `RSIGMA_MCP_DAEMON_TOKEN`).

http_addr.description:
Bind address for the Streamable HTTP transport (maps to `--http`).
Unset means stdio.

lint_config.description: Lint config file applied by the `lint_rules` tool (maps to `--lint-config`).

rules_dir.description: Default root for relative path-based tool calls (maps to `--rules-dir`).

allow_unconfined_paths.description:
Run without `rules_dir`, leaving tool path arguments unconfined (maps
to `--allow-unconfined-paths`). Required for the HTTP transport without
a root. Defaults to off.

allow_sigma_cli.description:
Allow the `convert_rules` tool to delegate targets without a native
backend to an installed sigma-cli (maps to `--allow-sigma-cli`).
Defaults to off.

daemon_url.description:
Base URL of a running daemon (maps to `--daemon-url`). Unset means the
operate-cycle tools stay unregistered.

daemon_ca.description:
Extra root CA PEM path for a self-signed daemon TLS listener (maps to
`--daemon-ca`).

allow_operate_writes.description:
Register the mutating operate tools (maps to `--allow-operate-writes`).
Defaults to off. The daemon token is deliberately absent: secrets stay
flag/env-only (`--daemon-token` / `RSIGMA_MCP_DAEMON_TOKEN`).
